lines: In the Scottish Highlands, a dark loch hides a very old warning.
A beautiful horse stands by the water, wet and shining.
Legend says it is a kelpie, waiting for tired travelers.
Touch its back, and your hand sticks fast to its hide.
Then it plunges into the loch and drags its rider under.
They say only an iron bridle can stop it, thrown over its head.
Then it must obey, and work for you like a plow horse.
But the kelpie never forgets, and it watches from the water.
So if you see a lone horse by a loch at night, would you climb on?
title: Never Touch the Horse by the Loch #shorts
description:
Scottish legend says the kelpie, a shining water horse, waits by the loch for tired travelers. Touch its back and you cannot let go.
